title.narrative: Tejiendo saberes en alianza para el cuidado y la soberanía alimentaria

description.narrative: The project is relevant because it responds to three interrelated problems that cross the lives of women, youth and indigenous peoples in Guatemala. First, it addresses inequality in care, making visible the historical overload faced by women and promoting training processes and community campaigns that promote co-responsibility and transform the cultural patterns that limit their autonomy. Second, it addresses the environmental and food crisis affecting rural communities, strengthening food sovereignty, climate justice, and the defense of community knowledge through training, content production, and dissemination in Mayan languages. Finally, it contributes to the organizational strengthening of the partner organisation consolidating their institutional sustainability, their advocacy capacities and their articulation in local, national and international networks. In this way, the project not only responds to urgent needs, but also proposes transformative alternatives to build more just, equitable and sustainable relationships in the territories. This project is based on several key assumptions. At the level of the social context, it is assumed that there will be minimum conditions to exercise freedom of expression, mobilization and community participation, without deepening the risks of criminalization of journalists or territorial leaders. Regarding the target population, it is assumed that there is openness, interest and capacity to participate in training processes, consume informative content and generate critical reflection. It is also assumed that the allied community media will continue to operate with sufficient autonomy to disseminate the content produced. At the organizational level, it is assumed that the partner organisation will maintain their operational stability and their key technical teams during the project period, and that they will be able to sustain the political and institutional commitment necessary to implement the planned training, production and accompaniment processes.
